title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
author: Dao, Fu, Ermon, Rudra and Ré (NeurIPS 2022)
why: The tiling and online-softmax argument, with the HBM-access analysis that explains why it is faster despite doing the same maths.

title: AWQ: Activation-aware Weight Quantization for LLM Compression and Acceleration
author: Lin et al. (MLSys 2024)
why: A clear treatment of why a small fraction of salient channels matters and how per-channel scaling protects them; its related-work section maps GPTQ, SmoothQuant and LLM.int8().

title: SGLang: Efficient Execution of Structured Language Model Programs
author: Zheng et al. (2023)
why: Introduces RadixAttention: the radix-tree KV cache, LRU eviction and cache-aware scheduling behind prefix reuse.

title: DistServe: Disaggregating Prefill and Decoding for Goodput-optimized Large Language Model Serving
author: Zhong et al. (OSDI 2024)
why: The case for separating prefill and decode pools, how interference hurts each phase, and goodput under TTFT and TPOT targets.
